Container.Name: Vacuula
Container.Overview: Custom server for the undead robot vacuum cleaners - revive your Neato with the power of Vacuula. Replaces the shut down Neato cloud for Gen3 (D3-D7) and Gen4 (D800, D8-D10) robots with a local server and web app: status, maps, runs, schedules, settings and zones.[br][br]Gen3 robots can only connect on port 443, which the Unraid web UI usually uses itself, so give this container its own IP address (Network Type: br0 / Custom, with a fixed IP). After starting, point your robot at that IP with the Vacuula installer, see the README.
Container.Requires: A dedicated IP for the container (br0 or another custom network). Gen3 robots require port 443 and Gen4 robots use port 3443 on that IP.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, maps, certificates, logs and plugins

Config.Name: mDNS
Config.Description: Advertise the server on the network for auto discovery (vacuula.local)

Config.Name: Web app port
Config.Description: Port of the web app and API. If you change it, update the WebUI port too

Config.Name: Bind address
Config.Description: Address to listen on, empty for all interfaces
